paper.title: Structured Research Agents for Reliable Paper Improvement

summary: The paper has a clear workflow contribution and credible audit stack, but the empirical evidence needs one stronger ablation package before submission.

originality.rationale: The contribution combines known workflow ideas in a useful research-agent setting.

evidence.note: The paper states a distinct structured evaluation layer.

originality.minimum_fix: Clarify which part is new relative to automated paper-review systems.

importance.rationale: Reliable AI-assisted research workflows are timely and practically important.

evidence.note: The motivation identifies reviewer bias and audit drift.

importance.minimum_fix: Quantify how often the baseline workflow misses quality failures.

claims_supported.rationale: Most claims have artifact support, but one evaluation claim lacks raw-result backing.

evidence.note: The audit reports WARN for one ambiguous mapping.

claims_supported.minimum_fix: Add raw evidence for the ambiguous claim or soften the claim.

experiment_soundness.rationale: The experiments are plausible but need one controlled ablation.

evidence.note: The main result exists but ablation coverage is thin.

experiment_soundness.minimum_fix: Run an ablation separating state export from quality evaluation.

writing_clarity.rationale: The narrative is readable and section structure is easy to follow.

evidence.note: Section order follows the workflow lifecycle.

writing_clarity.minimum_fix: Add a short glossary for workflow artifacts and audit states.

community_value.rationale: The artifact protocol and dashboard are useful to agent-tooling researchers.

evidence.note: The paper explains portability across host agents.

community_value.minimum_fix: Include a small user-facing case study.

prior_work_context.rationale: The related work mentions automated review, but the distinction from agentic reviewer systems can be sharper.

evidence.note: No REMOVE verdicts, but one FIX remains.

prior_work_context.minimum_fix: Add a paragraph comparing the rubric to Stanford Agentic Reviewer.

blocking_issues.issue: One quality-improvement claim has ambiguous raw evidence.
blocking_issues.minimum_fix: Attach the raw result file or soften the claim.

minimum_fixes.fix: Resolve the ambiguous numeric claim before declaring submission-ready.
Add one ablation for the state-center component.
